result:
I’d make the consequences of our actions impossible to ignore—not as abstract knowledge, but as felt understanding.

If every person could directly sense, even briefly, how their choices affect others—near, far, and future—much of the cruelty, indifference, and short-sightedness that sustains broken systems would lose its footing.
